lines: Big car jumps show your airtime, distance and height as you land from the cinematic view
Landing and taking off again counts as one jump, and the cinematic camera cuts to the new flight
Kayaks are quicker and glide between strokes
Boats bump into each other and into you, and paddle strokes sound like a real catch, swish and drip
The night sky shows every naked-eye star where it really is over Ann Arbor, with fewer downtown and none behind clouds
Shops now show a real furnished room with people inside when you get close, and each kind of business has its own look,
Restaurants have their own rooms and signs based on their cuisine
Cars now pull up at gas station pumps, and police cars have new Interceptor Utilities with real lettering and an electri
Hitting a police car now makes it chase you, and it only takes turns its lane allows
The railway bridge over North Main now sits level on solid supports, and bridges no longer block the roads beneath them
Patrol cruisers now pull you over for speeding, crashes and knocking people down, anywhere in town
In a chase, one cruiser speeds up to catch you, drives straight at you when close, and pulls up behind without ramming
Police show up on the map, and the radar flashes during a chase and stops when you get away
Place and street names now appear at the top left instead of the title badge
Huron River flow now comes from the USGS Water Data API
Traffic now runs into the second player in split screen, and their car knocks people down
A car taken from traffic no longer shows up again while you're driving it in split screen
The map search box starts empty each time you open the map
Radio keeps playing when the app is in a background tab
The sky is lit properly again under Now, with no black sky before sunset
Cars can knock down ball-diamond fence panels now
Police sirens now go off when traffic calls for them
Split-screen play starts up more smoothly
Champion flyovers work properly now
Pools, airstairs, and golf carts versus cars behave better now
The game starts up faster and runs more smoothly, especially in busy areas
Traffic, buses, trains and people move around town more naturally
Trees change with the seasons
Golf courses now follow their real layouts
The airport, sound, sky and map have all been improved
You can play golf now, with pull-back shots, a pulsing landing circle, and Escape to cancel a shot
Golf courses show up as landmarks and flags on the map, with numbered holes, tee signs, and distance to the hole
Greens are slower, rough shots are shorter, and rounds no longer end by accident when you hit a bump
Cars no longer drive on golf cart paths
Plane wing lights now have the right colors
The app fills the whole window, whatever its shape
The football stadium now has Skyline-style stands around it
High school football fields are on the map now
Pioneer's field has stands on both sides now
Stands no longer overlap nearby buildings
Map icons get smaller when you zoom out
Speed humps now have chevron markings that point the way you approach them, spaced out so they're easy to read
One-way streets now show arrows pointing the way traffic flows
Champion trees now show up on the map with their own icons and badges, and each has an info card with its height
You can fly over a champion tree for a closer look, then press T to exit
Trash, recycling and compost carts have new colors, and you can hit them again
There's a lighter mode now that helps the app run better on slower computers
The app runs more smoothly on your phone now
It crashes less often now
The game runs lighter on phones now
Search finds street addresses
Walking and bike braking feel smoother
Bike lanes match the city's map
The map reaches farther west now
Trees fill the land beyond the city limits
Freeways now run through town
Houses now look like the real ones on their streets, drafted from street photos instead of plain blocks
Many houses have front yards with trees, shrubs, hedges, fences, walks and driveways
Hedges stay clear of doors and driveways, and shrubs no longer go missing from yards
Houses, yards and animals load faster, and the birds are gone from the sky
The game no longer cuts out on Xbox, and trees and parking garages run faster there
Animals are gone on Xbox, and on other platforms they move more smoothly near trees
You'll notice fewer stutters while playing
Fly mode now starts you in the airport helicopter, and you can open or close your parachute with space
You can knock scooters flying, and main streets now have speed limit signs that sit in front of their posts
Two people can now play together on a split screen, and player 2 gets their own mini map
The game starts up faster, and getting into cars is quicker too
Cars now handle more realistically, with sharper turning and anti-lock brakes
You can climb and jump on the bleachers, even in a fast car
On Xbox, the game runs smoother and shows shadows and ground, and the black screen is gone
Deer, restrooms and seating now appear around town
The speedometer shows your speed as digits with a bar
The speedometer is sized to match the map
The car's name on the dial is simpler
Squirrels and river birds now live around town
You can spin the Cube
Gears no longer show up on vehicles without wheels
Parks, pools and street furniture fill out the city
Multi-storey parking structures are here, and boats at docks can be boarded
Touch controls are now icons only, so the view stays clean
A round analog speedometer shows how fast you're going
Touch screens have a single bar along the bottom
The bar gets more compact in narrow windows
The speedometer sits in the same spot as the map
The airport runs more smoothly now
The Gallup Park bridge is fully detailed now
The Michigan Union is fully detailed now
You can exit a boat into the water now
Boat owners swim ashore now, and the water under footbridges is open
There are bike racks around town now
A mini map shows you where you are
The airport is on the map now and connects to town
Planes are spread out across the airport, and the stair trucks look better
The stair trucks are easier to drive, and their stairs no longer vanish
Every corner of Ann Arbor is in the game now
New landmarks: the Michigan Theater, Graffiti Alley, the Gandy Dancer, the Diag's block M and Huron High
Tune in on the car radio, or bring your own music on earbuds
The helicopter flies up to 200 mph
Swim in the river, with splashes and a muddy riverbed
Jump out of a moving car or a flying helicopter and open your parachute
Record videos of your ride
Potholes from the city's road work, and speed limit signs
Kayaks and an underwater camera view
Drive down the playground slide
Ride buses and e-bikes, or drive dump trucks and excavators
New electric trucks and SUVs on the roads
Buildings look like the real ones, with live city data
Pull the handbrake for skid marks and tire smoke
Smoother hills, with houses on them
Kayak mode: paddle the Huron through the Argo Cascades
Real car crashes: knock down streetlights and send hydrants gushing
Drive into the stadium
Kayakers and tubers on the river
The city is Ann Arbor now, with real houses, driveways and house numbers
Railways, golf courses, churches, gas stations and historic districts
Land the helicopter on rooftops
Shop windows, doors and cycling traffic lights
